scope: Preserve the first T26 case failure when its restoration also fails, while recording a sanitized second failure through the existing native Profile error boundary.

behavior.dual_failure: The original primary Error object is rethrown. Its secondary restoration Error is retained in a nonenumerable diagnostic property; the report receives only allowlisted code profile_case_restoration_failed and an allowlisted restoration stage.
behavior.cleanup_only_failure: A fixed-code Error is thrown with the original cleanup Error as its nonenumerable cause. The runner report records the fixed code and allowlisted stage.
behavior.success: The real case still returns a provisional T26 receipt after restoring the owned row value; only the outer runner may confirm original row absence.

verification.boundary_test: node --test tests/browser/profile-save-failure-error-preservation.test.mjs — 3 passed, covering dual failure, cleanup-only failure, and success through the actual case function; dual and cleanup-only failures also traverse runProfileExecutionBoundary.

limits: The boundary test substitutes native panel and journal dependencies. It guards orchestration and report sanitation, not live Profile behavior.
The existing native runner already calls captureProfileExecutionFailure through runProfileExecutionBoundary; no runner edit was required.
